name: ffi_struct_layout
summary: Given an array of scalar type codes (from <ffi.h>), one per struct field, returns `({ total_size, ({ offset0, offset1, ... }) })` honoring the platform's alignment rules. Size an ffi_alloc() block to `total_size` and use the offsets with ffi_read()/ffi_write(). The tools/ffi generator emits these arrays from a C header.

availability.condition: 需要 PACKAGE_FFI 和 libffi；WebAssembly 目标不可用
